title: Nourishing Snappy Ethiopian Vegetables Atakilt Wat
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with a variety of vegetables and spices, served in an earthenware bowl. This recipe features coriander seeds and a lacquer-glaze for added flavor and texture.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the carrots and potatoes, and cook for 10 minutes, or until they are tender.
Stir in the ground coriander seeds, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve the Atakilt Wat in an earthenware bowl, garnished with lacquer-glaze if desired.
Traditionally, this dish is served with injera bread, but it can also be served on its own.
To add extra flavor, serve with a side of mitmita, a spicy Ethiopian chili powder.
